title: Storybook a11y CI matrix must list every theme that needs contrast coverage
answers: Why isn't a new/visual_refresh theme getting a11y contrast checks in CI?
Where do I add a theme to storybook accessibility testing?
How are grafana themes checked for WCAG contrast?
body: Storybook a11y tests run per-theme via a build matrix in .github/workflows/storybook-a11y.yml (STORYBOOK_THEME list). A theme defined in packages/grafana-data/src/themes/themeDefinitions/*.json is NOT automatically a11y-tested — its name must also be added to this matrix, or regressions in that theme's contrast (text/disabled/hover colors) go unnoticed. visual_refresh_dark and visual_refresh_light were added here explicitly to close that gap.
applies: Any PR adding a new theme variant or theme definition file
